name: Sunao Cool
source:
Tomoya loses a game and is ordered to tell two girls, Azami and Midori, that he loves them as a punishment. Midori is actually his childhood friend, though he doesn't talk with her much now. It's a hard punishment for him, but a girl, Mizuki, hears it and says, "I'll now tell you that I love you, so you won't need to do that punishment anymore." Like this, his school life gradually gets exciting surrounded by honest and cool girls....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090413062419/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012391]ErogeShop[/url]]
